title: Entities put to rest through lore/rite (no combat at all) are still labeled '(dead)' in the room header exactly like something I killed with a sword. Happened at least three times: St. Mara's Shrine ('St. Mara (dead)' after reading the vigil-plaque), the bloated drowned wight in Sunken Howe (the game's own text said 'these words were never meant for it' right before the header flipped to '(dead)'), and the frozen pilgrim at St. Ashwyn's Perch. It undercuts the narrative distinction the game otherwise draws between violence and peaceful rites.
where: St. Mara's Shrine — nave; Sunken Howe — chamber; The Pilgrims' Shrine — nave
